hello_welcome.text: Hello and welcome! How may I help you?
Hi, welcome! Can I help you?

booking_name.text: What name is the reservation under?

passport_id.text: May I see your passport or ID card, please?
Can I see your passport or ID card?

fill_form.text: Could you please fill in and sign this form?
Can you fill in and sign this form?

how_many_nights.text: How many nights will you be staying?
How many nights are you staying?

how_many_people.text: How many people are in your party?
How many of you are there?

room_not_ready.text: Your room isn't ready yet. It will be ready at around 2 pm.
Your room's not ready yet. It'll be ready around 2 pm.

leave_luggage.text: You're welcome to leave your luggage here in the meantime.
You can leave your bags here in the meantime.

room_number.text: Your room is number 214, on the second floor.
You're in 214, on the second floor.

elevator.text: The lift is on the right.

key_card.text: Here is your key card. It opens your room and the lift.
Here's your key card. It opens the room and the lift.

wifi_code.text: The Wi-Fi password is written on this card.

breakfast_hours.text: Breakfast is served from 7 to 10:30 am.

no_booking_found.text: I can't find your reservation. Do you have the confirmation number?
I can't find your booking. Have you got the confirmation number?

early_checkin.text: Can I get into the room earlier?

hotel_full.text: I'm sorry, the hotel is fully booked tonight.

pay_now_or_later.text: Would you like to pay now or at check-out?
Do you want to pay now or when you leave?

deposit.text: We ask for a 100-euro deposit, which is refunded at check-out.

card_or_cash.text: Will you be paying by card or in cash?
Are you paying by card or cash?

city_tax.text: The city tax is 2 euros per person per night.

tax_not_included.text: The city tax is not included in the booking price.

card_declined.text: I'm afraid your card has been declined. Do you have another card?
Your card's been declined. Have you got another one?

enter_pin.text: You can put your PIN in now.

invoice_company.text: Could you make the invoice out to my company?

price_night.text: How much is it per night?

cheaper_room.text: Do you have a cheaper room?

room_view.text: The room has a sea view.

double_twin.text: Would you prefer a double bed or two single beds?
Do you want a double or two singles?

extra_bed.text: We can add an extra bed for your child.

baby_cot.text: A baby cot is available free of charge.

air_con.text: The air-conditioning remote is on the bedside table.

safe.text: There is a safe in the wardrobe.

minibar.text: Drinks from the minibar are charged.

quiet_room.text: I'd like a quiet room, please.

hair_dryer.text: The hairdryer is in the bathroom.

adapter.text: Do you have a plug adapter?

iron.text: Could I have an iron, please?

extra_pillow.text: Could you bring me an extra pillow?

housekeeping_time.text: What time would you like your room to be cleaned?
What time do you want your room cleaned?

do_not_disturb.text: Please hang the "Do Not Disturb" sign on your door if you'd prefer not to be disturbed.
Put the "Do Not Disturb" sign out if you want some peace.

clean_now.text: May I clean your room now?
Can I clean the room now?

towels.text: Could I have some clean towels?

change_sheets.text: The sheets are changed every three days.

laundry.text: We have a laundry service. Your laundry is returned the next day.

found_item.text: We found this item in your room.
We found this in your room.

table_for.text: A table for how many, please?

breakfast_room.text: Breakfast is served on the ground floor, next to reception.

buffet.text: It's a buffet, so please help yourself.

allergy.text: Do you have any food allergies?
Have you got any food allergies?

room_service.text: Room service is available until 10 pm.

charge_room.text: Shall I charge it to your room?
Shall I put it on your room?

restaurant_closed.text: The restaurant is closed this evening.

recommend_restaurant.text: I can recommend a good restaurant nearby.
I know a good place to eat just round the corner.

problem_room.text: There's a problem with my room.

too_noisy.text: It's too noisy, I can't sleep.

card_not_working.text: My key card doesn't open the door any more.

locked_out.text: I've left my key card in the room.

sorry_problem.text: I'm terribly sorry about this problem.

send_technician.text: I'll send someone up to your room right away.
I'll send someone to your room right away.

fixed_soon.text: It will be fixed within an hour at the latest.

offer_new_room.text: I can offer you another room.
I can give you another room.

compensation.text: By way of apology, your breakfast is on us.
To make up for it, your breakfast is on us.

manager.text: I'd like to speak to the manager.

complaint_noted.text: I've made a note of your complaint. The manager will call you back.
I've noted your complaint. The manager will call you back.

taxi.text: Would you like me to call you a taxi?
Do you want me to call you a taxi?

airport_transfer.text: We offer an airport shuttle. It needs to be booked the day before.

map.text: Here's a map of the city.

bus_stop.text: The bus stop is right in front of the hotel.

atm.text: Where can I get some cash out?

book_tour.text: I can book a guided tour for you.
I can book you a guided tour.

safe_area.text: Is the area safe at night?

call_doctor.text: I'll call a doctor for you.
I'll call a doctor for you.

first_aid.text: We have a first-aid kit at reception.

fire_exit.text: The emergency exit is at the end of the corridor.

fire_alarm.text: The fire alarm is going off: leave by the stairs, not the lift.

late_checkout_fee.text: Late check-out until 2 pm costs 30 euros.

minibar_used.text: Did you have anything from the minibar?
Did you take anything from the minibar?

invoice_email.text: Would you like the invoice sent by email?
Do you want the invoice by email?

keep_luggage_after.text: We can keep your luggage for you after check-out.
We can hang on to your bags after check-out.

enjoyed_stay.text: Did you have a good stay?

leave_review.text: If you were happy with your stay, you're welcome to leave us a review online.
If you liked it, you can leave a review online.

goodbye.text: Thank you, and have a safe journey!

colleague_help.text: Can you give me a hand at reception?

guest_waiting.text: There's a guest waiting at the front desk.

vip_arrival.text: A VIP guest is arriving at 3 pm.

shift_change.text: I finish at 6 pm, who's taking over from me?

broken_report.text: The shower in 305 is leaking, we need to tell maintenance.
